side_source.test_record_silent_groove: silent groove of the test record
setting.retention_days.label: Keep original audio for
setting.retention_days.help: After that only the WAV file is deleted; measurements, spectrogram and grades stay. 0 = never delete.
setting.autostop_end_groove.label: Stop the recording in the run-out groove
setting.autostop_end_groove.help: Stops as soon as the stylus has circled three revolutions in the run-out groove. Does not apply to calibration.
setting.max_record_minutes.label: Longest recording
setting.max_record_minutes.help: The recording stops after this. An LP side lasts up to about 30 minutes.
setting.min_free_gb.label: Minimum free space for recording
setting.min_free_gb.help: Below this, no new recording starts. A side needs about 0.2 GB per 20 minutes.
setting.discogs_sync_minutes.label: Sync the Discogs collection every
setting.discogs_sync_minutes.help: In the background, one request per 100 records. If a search finds nothing, it also syncs right away.
setting.clip_grace_s.label: Clipping: grace period at start and end
setting.clip_grace_s.help: For this long after the stylus drops and before it lifts, clipping does not count (touchdown, dust cover, hand on the platter). After the music has ended it never counts.
setting.clip_mention_samples.label: Mention clipping from
setting.clip_mention_samples.help: Below this it only appears in the technical data. 48 samples are one millisecond.
setting.clip_max_samples.label: Clipping: no grade from
setting.clip_max_samples.help: Above this the count is no longer reliable; the recording gets no grade and the warning sign.
setting.engineer_mode.label: Engineer mode
setting.engineer_mode.help: Measure recordings against the digital master of the side, e.g. for test pressings: upload one master per side on the record page. Every recording of that side is measured against it after the analysis (speed, center hole, frequency response, level, clicks only on the vinyl, noise and pre-echo in the gaps).
setting.learn_enabled.label: Learn from master comparisons and judgments
setting.learn_enabled.help: Estimates per recording how many of the reported clicks are genuine and shows that next to the count. Learns from every new master comparison and every judgment.
setting.learn_grade.label: Calculate the grade from the estimate
setting.learn_grade.help: The grade then uses the estimated genuine clicks instead of the reported ones (only for kinds whose estimate has proven itself in cross-validation). Only switch this on once the estimate also matches what you hear on records without a master.
approval_check.hf_end: Treble at the end of the side
setting.update_check.label: Look for new versions
setting.update_check.help: Once a day, ask GitHub for the latest release of vinyl-check and show a note when a newer version is out. Only the version number is sent.
